turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Sharma, I am Rohan from the Global Task Center in Bengaluru. I am calling regarding the part-time data optimization project you expressed interest in.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hello? I do not remember applying for any project. Which website was this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was through the social media advertisement sir. You can earn five thousand rupees daily just by liking videos on your phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Five thousand? That sounds very high for just liking videos. Is it really possible?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, it is a very simple system. Just to start your account and activate the first batch, you need to deposit a small security fee of twelve thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand is a lot of money for me to just give like that. Why do I have to pay first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is only for verification of your bank account so we can send your daily commissions. Once you pay, you get the amount back with a twenty percent bonus immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am still not sure. Can you send me an email or some official letter first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the offer is only for today. If you transfer the twelve thousand rupees now via UPI, I will personally ensure your first profit is credited within ten minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will have to ask my son. Let me call him and then I will tell you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not waste time Mr. Sharma. Just send the money now and I will give you the link to start earning immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know, I feel something is wrong here. I will call you back later.
